primary_sources.title: Convex Optimization
primary_sources.established_content: Norm-to-linear constraints are classical second-order cone constraints. KKT conditions certify convex optimality under the stated regularity. The limiting formula uses elementary Hilbert-space geometry; no general optimization principle is claimed.

primary_sources.title: Prediction-Powered LLM Ranking with Adaptively Collected Human Feedback
primary_sources.established_content: Prediction correction for preferences,action-specific variance tuning and variance-constrained resource allocation are prior. Theorem1 supplies a bounded approximate-root sequence in its ranking setup.
primary_sources.specific_scope_difference: The present law has proportional Gaussian utility dimension,known whole-utility scale and fixed IID samples. It optimizes the unrestricted compensated attainment boundary under a regular covariance multiplier. These distinctions do not prove priority or superiority.
primary_sources.uninspected_scope: Supplementary assumptions and proofs referenced as S1–S4 were not substantively audited. No claim about the complete procedure's failure or performance is made.
